summary: Regencell Bioscience Holdings Ltd filed Form 6-K announcing a registered direct offering of 985,222 ordinary shares at $20.30 per share, led by a $19 million investment from a new institutional investor with Univest Securities as placement agent. The offering is expected to close on May 20, 2026, and is made under an existing shelf registration statement (Form F-3). This is a routine equity financing, not a special situation such as a going-private, restructuring, or tender offer. No special-situation triggers are present; the filing is an ordinary capital markets transaction.
